title: Baggage Acceptance Standard: Weight and Size Limits for Crestline Fare Brands
content:
**Airport Services acceptance standard for Crestline Tickets by Fare Brand.** A checked bag is weighed in pounds and measured in linear inches (length plus width plus height taken together). The limits below decide when a weight or size charge arises and when a bag is refused as checked baggage.

## Weight

| Fare brand | Weight allowance (lb) | First overweight band upper limit (lb) | Heaviest bag accepted (lb) | First overweight band charge (USD) | Second overweight band charge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | 50 | 70 | 100 | 100 | 200 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | 50 | 70 | 100 | 100 | 200 |
| Crestline Main Plus | 50 | 70 | 100 | 100 | 200 |
| Crestline Main Flexible | 50 | 70 | 100 | 100 | 200 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | 70 | 70 | 100 | 100 | 200 |
| Crestline First | 70 | 70 | 100 | 100 | 200 |

## Size

| Fare brand | Standard size (linear inches) | Largest size accepted (linear inches) | Oversize charge (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Basic Economy | 62 | 115 | 200 |
| Crestline Main Cabin | 62 | 115 | 200 |
| Crestline Main Plus | 62 | 115 | 200 |
| Crestline Main Flexible | 62 | 115 | 200 |
| Crestline Premium Economy | 62 | 115 | 200 |
| Crestline First | 62 | 115 | 200 |

## Definitions

- The **weight allowance** is the weight up to which a checked bag carries no weight charge.
- The **first overweight band** runs above the weight allowance up to the band limit; the **second overweight band** runs above the band limit up to the heaviest weight accepted.
- A bag heavier than the heaviest weight accepted, or larger than the largest size accepted, must travel as cargo.
- For Crestline Premium Economy and Crestline First the weight allowance (70 lb) equals the first band limit, so any bag above 70 lb and up to 100 lb falls in the second band.
